      Booking Process

      How Our Air Ticket Service Works

      From sharing your travel plan to receiving your boarding-ready e-ticket in four simple steps.

      01

      Share Your Travel Plan

      Tell us your departure city (Dhaka, Chittagong, or Sylhet), destination, preferred travel dates, number of passengers, and any airline preference. We'll also ask about your baggage needs and cabin class preference.

      02

      Compare Fares & Airlines

      Our team scans 50+ airlines and presents you with the best 3-5 fare options. Each option includes transit details, total journey time, baggage allowance, meal service, and fare rules — so you can make an informed decision.

      03

      Confirm & Pay Securely

      Select your preferred flight and review the complete fare breakdown including taxes, surcharges, and baggage fees. Pay securely via bKash, bank transfer, or credit/debit card. We confirm the booking before you pay — no surprises.

      04

      Receive Your E-Ticket

      Your confirmed e-ticket with PNR number, flight schedule, and detailed travel instructions (terminal info, check-in time, transit guidance) are delivered to your email within 30 minutes of payment.

      FAQ

      Frequently Asked Questions

      Baggage allowance varies by airline and fare class. Most full-service airlines (Biman, Singapore Airlines, Emirates, Thai Airways) offer 30-40 kg checked baggage plus 7 kg cabin baggage in economy class. Budget carriers like AirAsia typically include 20 kg with options to add more. We always specify the exact allowance for every fare option we present.

      Most Bangladeshi passport holders do not need a transit visa for connections under 24 hours in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, or Dubai. However, requirements vary by route and transit duration. We verify all transit visa requirements for your specific itinerary before booking and advise you well in advance.

      Refund policies depend on the airline and fare class you book. We clearly communicate all cancellation rules, penalties, and refund timelines before you make any payment. For flexible fares, most airlines offer a partial refund minus applicable fees. We handle the entire refund process on your behalf with the airline.

      Yes, date changes are possible on most fares subject to airline change fees and fare difference. We assist you with the entire rebooking process. Some flexible fares allow free changes up to a certain date. Contact our 24/7 support team as soon as you know your plans have changed for the best options.

      For the best fares, we recommend booking 4-8 weeks in advance for regional flights (Bangkok, Singapore, KL) and 6-12 weeks for long-haul destinations (Tokyo, London, Istanbul). However, last-minute deals are sometimes available. Contact us for real-time fare availability regardless of your timeline.

      Absolutely! We offer special group rates for 10 or more passengers traveling together. Corporate clients also receive dedicated account management, flexible payment terms, and consolidated invoicing. Family bookings of 4+ passengers may qualify for discounted group fares on select airlines. Contact us with your group details for a custom quote.

      FAQ

      Frequently Asked Questions

      Most full-service airlines offer 30–40 kg checked baggage plus 7 kg cabin baggage for economy class. Budget carriers like AirAsia typically include 20 kg which can be upgraded. We specify the exact allowance for each fare option during booking.

      Refund policies depend on the airline and fare class. We clearly communicate cancellation rules before booking. For flexible fares, most airlines offer a partial refund minus cancellation fees. We assist with the entire refund process at no extra charge.

      Most Bangladeshi passengers do not need a transit visa for connections under 24 hours in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, or Bangkok. We verify transit requirements based on your specific route and nationality before booking.

      E-tickets are delivered to your email within 30 minutes of payment confirmation. For complex multi-city bookings, it may take up to 2 hours. You'll also receive detailed travel instructions and terminal guidance.

      Yes, date changes are possible for most fares. Change fees and fare differences apply depending on the airline and ticket type. We handle the rebooking process for you — just contact us with your new preferred dates.

        Visa Assistance

        Hassle-free visa processing for Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore & more. Expert documentation, embassy liaison, and a 95% approval rate.

        Why Choose Us

        Stress-Free Visa Processing

        Navigating visa requirements can be overwhelming. Our dedicated visa team has processed over 5,000 Thailand tourist visas for Bangladeshi travelers with a 95% approval rate. We handle every detail — from document preparation to embassy submission — so you can focus on planning your trip.

        • Expert document review — we catch issues before submission to prevent rejection
        • Direct embassy liaison for faster processing and priority appointments
        • Real-time status updates via WhatsApp at every stage of your application
        • Free re-submission assistance if your application needs additional documents
        Process

        How It Works

        From free consultation to visa approval — a smooth, guided process.

        01

        Free Consultation

        Share your travel plans and passport details. We assess your eligibility and advise on the best visa category.

        02

        Document Collection

        We provide a precise checklist and help you prepare every document — bank statements, NOC, photos, and itinerary.

        03

        Submission & Tracking

        Our team submits your application to the embassy and monitors progress with real-time WhatsApp updates.

        04

        Visa Approval

        Once approved, we collect your passport with the visa stamp and deliver it to you or arrange courier service.

        Visa Services

        Popular Visa Options

        5–7 Working Days

        Thailand Tourist Visa

        Single-entry tourist visa valid for 60 days stay. Includes document review, form filling, and embassy submission.

        ৳8,000
        3–5 Working Days

        Malaysia Tourist Visa

        e-Visa processing for 30-day stay. Simple documentation with fast turnaround and high approval rate.

        ৳6,500
        5–7 Working Days

        Singapore Tourist Visa

        30-day stay visa with complete documentation support. Ideal for combining with your Thailand trip.

        ৳10,000

        Frequently Asked Questions

        Standard processing takes 5–7 working days from the date of embassy submission. We also offer an urgent processing option (3–4 working days) for an additional fee, subject to embassy capacity.

        Key documents include: valid passport (6+ months), bank statement (3 months), NOC from employer, passport-size photos (white background), confirmed flight & hotel booking, and a completed visa application form. We provide the full checklist during your free consultation.

        In the rare case of rejection, our team analyzes the reason, helps you address any gaps in documentation, and assists with re-submission at no additional service fee. Our 95% approval rate means most applications succeed on the first attempt.

        Need a Visa? We've Got You Covered

        Start with a free consultation. Our visa experts handle the paperwork while you plan your dream Thailand vacation.

        Food & Culinary Tours

        Street food crawls in Bangkok, Thai cooking classes in Chiang Mai, seafood feasts in Phuket — experience Thailand through its incredible flavors.

        Why Choose Us

        Taste the Real Thailand

        Thailand's street food scene is legendary — from the fiery som tum stalls of Bangkok's Yaowarat Road to the aromatic curries of Chiang Mai's night markets. Our local foodie guides take you beyond tourist restaurants to the authentic eats that locals love. Learn the secrets of Thai cuisine in hands-on cooking classes and bring the flavors home.

        • Local foodie guides who are passionate Thai cuisine experts and lifelong food lovers
        • Access to hidden street food spots, family-run kitchens, and market stalls tourists rarely find
        • Cooking class certificate and recipe book to take home and recreate your favorite dishes
        • All food and drinks included — come hungry and leave with a full stomach and happy heart
        Process

        How It Works

        Choose your culinary adventure and let our foodie guides take care of the rest.

        01

        Choose Your Tour

        Pick from our curated food tours: street food crawl, cooking class, floating market, or seafood feast. Each has a unique flavor.

        02

        Meet Your Guide

        Your local foodie guide greets you at the meeting point with an introduction to the day's culinary journey.

        03

        Explore & Taste

        Walk through markets, cook dishes from scratch, and sample 8–12 different dishes. Your guide explains every ingredient and technique.

        04

        Take Home Recipes

        Receive a digital recipe book with all the dishes you learned. Cooking class participants also get a certificate.

        Photography Tours

        Capture Thailand's most iconic moments — sunrise at Wat Arun, lantern-lit Yi Peng, hill tribe portraits, and dramatic island landscapes.

        Why Choose Us

        Shoot Like a Pro in Thailand

        Thailand is a photographer's paradise — golden temples at dawn, vibrant night markets, misty mountain temples, and bioluminescent bays. Our photography tours are led by professional Thai photographers who know exactly when and where to capture the magic. From smartphone shooters to DSLR enthusiasts, we help you get the shot.

        • Professional photographer guide with local knowledge of secret viewpoints and timing
        • Golden hour scheduling — we plan every session around the best natural light conditions
        • Post-processing tips and Lightroom presets included to enhance your photos
        • Small groups of 2–6 people ensuring personalized attention and unobstructed views
        Process

        How It Works

        From selecting your theme to sharing your best shots on social media.

        01

        Select Your Theme

        Choose from temple photography, street life, landscapes, portraits, or night photography. Each has unique locations and techniques.

        02

        Schedule Golden Hours

        We plan sessions around sunrise and sunset for the most dramatic lighting. Early starts mean fewer crowds and better shots.

        03

        Guided Shooting Session

        Your pro photographer guides you to the best spots, helps with composition, camera settings, and captures group photos of you.

        04

        Edit & Share

        Get post-processing tips, Lightroom presets, and a shared online gallery with the guide's best shots from the session.

          Who We Are

          InfinityPath — Your Trusted Travel Partner Since 2009

          InfinityPath is a premier travel agency headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, dedicated to crafting extraordinary travel experiences for adventurers, families, and corporate clients across the globe. We combine deep local expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver seamless, personalized journeys.

          From international tour packages and flight bookings to hotel reservations and visa assistance, we handle every aspect of your travel with meticulous attention to detail. Our team of experienced travel consultants works tirelessly to ensure each trip exceeds expectations.

          Our Journey

          Our Story

          From a small travel desk to a globally recognized travel platform — here's how we got here.

          2009

          Founded

          InfinityPath started as a small travel agency in Dhaka with a team of 3 passionate travel enthusiasts and a dream to make international travel accessible.

          2012

          First International Tour

          Launched our first international group tour to Thailand, successfully serving 45 travelers and earning our first batch of five-star reviews.

          2016

          1,000+ Happy Travelers

          Crossed the milestone of 1,000 satisfied travelers. Expanded our destination network to 10+ countries across Asia and Europe.

          2019

          Global Partnerships

          Established partnerships with 200+ hotels, 50+ airlines, and tourism boards worldwide. Opened our Bangkok regional office.

          2023

          AI-Powered Travel Platform

          Launched our smart booking platform with AI-powered itinerary planning, real-time availability, and instant confirmation for thousands of services.

          2025

          Future Expansion

          Expanding to Middle East and African destinations. 50,000+ travelers served and counting. Building the future of travel technology.

          Purpose

          The driving forces behind everything we do at InfinityPath.

          Our Mission

          To deliver a customer-first travel experience that is seamless, transparent, and memorable. We are committed to providing end-to-end travel solutions with personalized attention, ensuring every traveler feels supported, valued, and inspired throughout their journey. Our mission extends beyond booking — we aim to be your trusted travel companion from the first dream to the last memory.

          Our Vision

          To become one of the world's most trusted travel platforms, recognized for innovation, reliability, and exceptional customer experiences. We envision a future where technology and human expertise combine to make world-class travel accessible to everyone — where every journey is perfectly planned, every moment is cherished, and every traveler returns home with stories worth telling for a lifetime.

          Got Questions?

          Frequently Asked Questions

          Everything you need to know about traveling with InfinityPath.

          Booking is simple! Browse our tour packages online, select your preferred package, fill out the inquiry form, and our travel consultant will contact you within 2 hours to finalize the details. You can also reach us directly via WhatsApp or phone for immediate assistance.
          We offer free cancellation up to 7 days before the travel date for most packages. Cancellations within 3-7 days incur a 25% fee, and within 3 days a 50% fee. Special deals and promotional packages may have specific cancellation terms which will be clearly stated at the time of booking.
          Yes! We provide comprehensive visa assistance for 30+ countries including Thailand, India, Malaysia, Singapore, Turkey, and many more. Our visa success rate is over 95%. We handle document preparation, application submission, and follow-up with embassies on your behalf.
          Absolutely! While we offer carefully curated pre-designed packages, every tour can be customized to your preferences. Want to add an extra day, change hotels, include specific activities, or adjust the itinerary? Our travel consultants will tailor the perfect package for you at no additional planning fee.
          We accept bank transfers, bKash, Nagad, credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), and cash payments at our offices. For international clients, we also accept PayPal and wire transfers. All online payments are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.
          Basic travel insurance is included in our premium packages. For standard packages, travel insurance can be added at a small additional cost. We strongly recommend all travelers have comprehensive travel insurance covering medical emergencies, trip cancellation, and baggage protection.
          We recommend booking at least 3-4 weeks in advance for standard tours and 6-8 weeks for peak season travel (December-February). However, we can also accommodate last-minute bookings with our fast-track processing service. Popular destinations during peak season fill up quickly, so earlier booking ensures the best availability and rates.
          Yes! We offer attractive group discounts for parties of 6 or more travelers. Group discounts typically range from 10-20% depending on the package and group size. We also offer special corporate rates for business travel and team-building retreats. Contact our team for a custom group quote.
          Our 24/7 support team monitors all flights and will immediately assist with rebooking or alternative arrangements. If a flight cancellation affects your tour, we'll work with our airline partners to get you on the next available flight and adjust your itinerary accordingly at no extra cost to you.
          Of course! Tour extensions are subject to availability and may incur additional costs. Simply contact your travel consultant before or during your trip, and we'll arrange the extension including hotel bookings, activities, and any visa extensions if needed. Many travelers add 2-3 extra days to explore on their own.

            FAQ

            Frequently Asked Questions

            Quick answers to help you before reaching out.

            For the best pricing and availability, we recommend booking 30–60 days in advance. During peak travel seasons like Eid, Christmas, and New Year, booking 60–90 days ahead ensures you get your preferred hotels and flight schedules. Last-minute bookings are possible but may have limited options and higher prices.

            Yes, we offer urgent visa processing for select countries after a thorough profile review. Additional expedite fees apply depending on the country and processing timeline. Contact us with your intended travel date and destination for an accurate assessment and timeline.

            Absolutely! We specialize in creating fully customized travel plans for families, honeymooners, corporate groups, and solo adventurers. Simply share your preferred destinations, budget range, travel dates, and any special interests — our team will craft a personalized itinerary just for you.

            We accept bank transfers, bKash, Nagad, all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), and cash payments. For packages above ৳50,000, we also offer convenient installment plans with 0% interest. All transactions are fully secured and documented.

            Yes, airport pickup and drop-off are included in all our standard tour packages. We also offer standalone transfer services for travelers who only need transportation. Our fleet includes sedans, SUVs, microbuses, and premium vehicles — all with professional drivers.

            We understand that plans change. Our flexible cancellation policy allows free cancellation up to 15 days before travel for most packages. Between 7–15 days, a small fee applies. Within 7 days, cancellation fees vary by service type. Changes to dates or destinations can be accommodated subject to availability.

            Yes! Groups of 10+ travelers enjoy exclusive discounted rates. We also provide comprehensive corporate travel management services including dedicated account managers, customized billing, and detailed expense reporting for businesses.
